explanation.text: The Logic: NIFTY Indices Ltd reviews the NIFTY 50 constituents on a semi-annual cycle, with the reconstitution effective in March and September each year. Eligibility is reassessed against criteria such as free-float market capitalisation, liquidity, and listed-history rules, with public advance notice so passive trackers can rebalance their holdings without disruption. The Trap: Daily or weekly rebalancing would create excessive turnover and tracking cost for passive funds. "Never" is incorrect because constituents do change as companies grow, decline, or get delisted. Note: The NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook (Sep 2025) supports the general principle that index rebalancing changes are publicly announced and that passive funds adjust around such announcements, but does not state the specific March/September NIFTY 50 frequency on the cited pages. The frequency is general index-methodology knowledge from NSE/NIFTY Indices publications.
